subject.title: [Bug]: Codex final reply is dropped after native shell completion in iMessage

question: Should the protected iMessage/Codex silent-reply report be assigned for owner-led current-main reproduction and a focused projection/final-delivery fix?
rationale: The report has a concrete high-impact signature, but protected-label handling and the unavailable current-main/Codex contract inspection prevent safe automated routing or closure.

options.title: Assign owner-led reproduction
options.body: Reproduce the exact native-shell completion path on a real iMessage setup, then repair the responsible Codex projection or final-delivery boundary.

options.title: Request a current-main trace
options.body: Ask the reporter for a redacted current-main trajectory and Gateway log if an owner cannot reproduce the scenario immediately.

recommendation.title: Assign owner-led reproduction
recommendation.body: Reproduce the exact native-shell completion path on a real iMessage setup, then repair the responsible Codex projection or final-delivery boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the detailed reproduction and are the only evidence-backed person connected to the adjacent iMessage path in the available context.
